method: Reviewed every candidate responsibility, procedure, output, hard gate, mutation scope, trigger, anti-trigger, and neighbor against its Phase 2 capability provenance.
Computed pairwise lexical overlap across positive trigger corpora; only rendered critique versus evidence-based release gating met the 0.25 review threshold and was manually adjudicated.

Reviewed the 17-step Recipe graph for conditional reachability, permission and mutation-scope preservation, review/remediation separation, current-render evidence, human checkpoints, feedback invalidation, and absence of remote writes.
Verified all Skill and Recipe evaluation plans remain planned and not-run-phase-9.

resolved_findings.finding: The first candidate Recipe recorded only broad permission_identity values, so workspace-write steps that were limited to run-output could be reinterpreted as source writers at Recipe level.
resolved_findings.resolution: Every Recipe step now carries the candidate's exact mutation_scope, and the Gate compares both permission_identity and mutation_scope with the referenced contract.

resolved_findings.finding: The Phase 2 external token capability has workspace-write identity but no external-read authority; wording could have implied autonomous website capture.
resolved_findings.resolution: The candidate accepts only supplied authorized captures or files, explicitly forbids browse/fetch/access-control bypass, writes only a run-output normalization report, and requires a separate design-system Skill for project token writes.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial Recipe branches for preservation, external tokens, prototype selection, visual system, authentic content, motion, and AI UX were reachable from route but did not explicitly rejoin the main flow.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added conditional branch-to-main edges with human approval for token adoption and prototype promotion; Gate verifies acyclicity and reachability.

resolved_findings.finding: Accessibility validation wording initially implied it could run tools despite a workspace-write identity with no local-exec host action.
resolved_findings.resolution: It now evaluates supplied current deterministic-check outputs and manual assistive records; browser/runtime acquisition remains owned by the artifact-only evidence Skill.

boundary_samples.boundary: Direction establishes evidence-backed user-flow, information hierarchy, spatial thesis, and human-owned choices; visual language implements the approved grammar; responsive composition owns page-level reflow, density, and stress conditions.
External extraction reads only supplied authorized evidence and emits candidate mappings; project-token and component persistence starts only after human approval in the design-system candidate.

Responsive composition owns semantic order, grid, density, and reflow; interaction owns controls, forms, navigation, async and recovery behavior; accessibility specifies and validates task-linked assistive outcomes without implementing either.

Content owns truthful words, realistic records, licensed assets, and state copy; visual language owns purposeful presentation rules and anti-template controls without inventing product claims or assets.

Motion communicates approved hierarchy or state with deterministic interruption and reduced motion; AI UX owns probabilistic latency, uncertainty, provenance, correction, and escalation whether animated or static.
Preservation inventories product truth, routes, IA, SEO, analytics, content, behavior, and migration constraints; direction may redesign only within those approved invariants.

Evidence acquisition defines and captures the current route-state-viewport matrix without judgment; rendered critique issues reproducible UI findings; evidence-based release gating maps independent findings to release criteria and human-owned disposition.

Preflight detects cross-domain omissions using current evidence; release gating consolidates criterion-linked independent findings; neither may mutate source, and accepted repair must route through a separate capability after explicit human authorization.

Both consume current renders, but critique performs specialist visual and interaction diagnosis while release gating aggregates criteria and risk into a bounded recommendation. The former cannot satisfy the latter alone.
The Recipe can conditionally orchestrate contracts and invalidate evidence; humans retain taste selection, prototype promotion, repair approval, risk acceptance, and final release disposition.

release_claim: none; all 17 Skills and the Recipe remain evaluating, with all evaluation plans not-run-phase-9
